title: SDLC review findings (one pass)
description: Output of one review pass (Bugs, Security or Compliance) by the sdlc-reviewer subagent or a headless claude -p review step. Only findings with confidence >= 80 are reported; the rest are counted in dropped_low_confidence.

pass.description: The single REVIEW.md pass this output covers.

findings.description: Reported findings, most severe first. Empty when nothing survived verification.

severity.description: As defined in REVIEW.md 'What Important means here'. Pre-existing = a real bug this diff did not introduce.

line.description: 1-indexed line in the post-change file (pre-change file for deletions).

title.description: The defect in one short sentence.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input or state, and the wrong output, crash, leak or policy breach that follows.

evidence.description: The code trace that proves it: the call path and the lines read (file:line), not a restatement of the title.

confidence.description: Confidence the finding is real and in scope. Findings below 80 are not reported.

reference.description: For Compliance: the requirement or rule violated (FR-001, SC-002, plan.md section, REVIEW.md or CLAUDE.md rule). Empty string if none.

suggested_fix.description: Smallest change that removes the failure. Empty string if not obvious.

nits_omitted.description: Nits found beyond the REVIEW.md cap, counted but not listed.

dropped_low_confidence.description: Candidate findings discarded because confidence was below 80 or the claim could not be verified in code.

plan_claims_falsified.description: Claims in plan.md or the PR description that the code contradicts (Compliance pass; may be empty for other passes).

not_reviewed.description: Files or areas in the diff that were skipped and why (REVIEW.md 'Do not report', unreadable, denied).

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was reviewed, counts by severity, and the single most important finding.
